game.name: Honkai: Star Rail
game.notes: Version 4.6 'Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise' live since 2026-09-27 (NA) / 2026-09-28 (EU/Asia); 4.7 expected 2026-11-10 (NA) / 2026-11-11 (EU/Asia). The 4.7 Special Program livestream has not been officially dated (community trackers expect 2026-10-30).

events.title: Love, Ghosts & Robots
events.summary: Help Skott's mechatron workshop meet production quotas so he can reject an unwanted marriage proposal.
events.description: Skott of the IPC finds himself facing an unwanted marriage proposal and ropes the Trailblazer into running his mechatron workshop to buy his way out. You assemble chips and design mechatrons across a series of production-line orders and Star Rating Assessment puzzle stages featuring characters like Dr. Ratio, Sushang, Aventurine, and Ruan Mei. Raising the workshop's production line and design levels unlocks story beats and a Trailblaze Fashion headwear.
events.gameplay: Slot chips into assessment boards to hit target star ratings, complete workshop orders, and level up the production line to improve mechatron stats (B/A/S ranks). Puzzle-and-management gameplay with no direct combat.
requirements: Complete the 'Good Hunting' Trailblaze Mission (part of Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise)
Trailblaze Level 21+ to unlock early via Finality's Vision

events.title: Wishpower UP! Down with Voracity!
events.summary: Defeat Voracity-corrupted enemies to accumulate Wishpower and help Aha (Nihilux) recover her strength for milestone rewards.
events.description: Enemies across the cosmos have been corrupted by the Voracity, and Aha needs Wishpower to fight back. Defeating corroded enemies grants Wishpower (4/10/40 depending on corruption level), which feeds a server-wide Suppression progress bar unlocking stacking combat buffs for everyone. First-time clears in Treasure Lightward endgame modes grant bonus Wishpower.
events.gameplay: Fight Voracity-corrupted enemies anywhere (bonus for first clears in Treasure Lightward) and hit personal Wishpower milestones for rewards while server-wide progress unlocks global buffs.
requirements: Complete the Adventure Mission 'Calyx (Golden): Bud of Memories' (official event notice)

rewards.note: 200 at 300 Wishpower + 300 at 1000 Wishpower
6 milestones x3; used for Astral Imagea draws
commemorative medal at 2000 Wishpower

events.rewardsSummary: 500 Stellar Jade + 18 Trendible Voucher + Pulling a Beast's Tooth medal (plus 30 Stellar Jade from the linked web event 'The Laughter Outsmarts miHoYo' share)

events.title: Astral Imagea
events.summary: Collect the IPC's blind-box Astral Imagea pet toys, trade them with players, and display them in the new Party Car Pet House and Astral Imagea Park.
events.description: The IPC's latest toy line, Astral Imagea, arrives as blind-box collectible critters in Classic and Collector's Editions (17 variants each, Kitty Furb and Chimera families). Draw with Trendible Vouchers, trade duplicates at the Trade Plaza, arrange pets in the Party Car's new Pet House, and show them off in the social Astral Imagea Park hub.
events.gameplay: Spend Trendible Vouchers on the Astral Trendible Draw (1 voucher = 1 random Imagea; guarantee within 6 draws), then collect, trade, and display pets.

rewards.note: free login gift during 4.6; 24 free total including 18 from Wishpower UP! event
random blind-box pet per pull; 34 variants total (17 Classic, 17 Collector's Edition)

events.rewardsSummary: 24 free Trendible Voucher (6 login + 18 from Wishpower event) for random Astral Imagea pets; extra vouchers cost Oneiric Shards

events.title: 4.6 Gift of Odyssey
events.summary: Log in for 7 days (need not be consecutive) during Version 4.6 to claim 10 Star Rail Special Passes.
events.description: The recurring version login event returns for Version 4.6. Check in on seven separate days during the event period to claim a total of ten Star Rail Special Passes from the event page.
events.gameplay: Open the event page and claim the day's login reward; days do not need to be consecutive.

rewards.note: total across 7 login days

events.title: Fate Contract: Renewal (Free Fate Collab Character)
events.summary: Log in during the Fate/stay night collaboration rerun to claim a free 5-star Gilgamesh or Archer.
events.description: As part of the Fate Collab Part 2 (featuring Rin Tohsaka and Gilgamesh), players can log in and claim a free copy of one of the Fate collaboration 5-star characters: Gilgamesh or Archer. The event runs from late July 2026 until the end of Version 4.6.
events.gameplay: Simply log in during the event window and claim the free character from the event page.

rewards.note: choose one free Fate collab 5-star character

events.rewardsSummary: 1 free 5-star Fate collab character (Gilgamesh or Archer)

events.title: Pearl Character Event Warp
events.summary: Version 4.6's new 5-star Ice/Elation character Pearl is featured for the entire patch alongside 4-stars Qingque, Xueyi, and Misha.
events.description: Pearl, a new 5-star Ice character following the Path of Elation, headlines Version 4.6's Character Event Warp and runs for the full version. The rate-up 4-stars are Qingque, Xueyi, and Misha. Her signature Light Cone 'Colors for Tomorrow' is featured on the Brilliant Fixation banner for the same duration (27 Sep - 10 Nov 2026).
events.gameplay: Standard Character Event Warp: spend Star Rail Special Passes; 5-star guaranteed within 90 pulls with 50/50 featured rate-up.
events.rewardsSummary: Warp banner (no event rewards); featured 5-star Pearl + 4-star Qingque/Xueyi/Misha; signature Light Cone 'Colors for Tomorrow' on Brilliant Fixation

events.title: Evanescia Rerun Character Event Warp
events.summary: Phase 1 rerun banner for 5-star Physical/Elation Evanescia, with 4-stars Qingque, Xueyi, and Misha.
events.description: Evanescia (5-star, Physical, Path of Elation) returns on a rerun Character Event Warp in Phase 1 of Version 4.6, running alongside Pearl's banner from 27 Sep to 21 Oct 2026. The rate-up 4-stars are Qingque, Xueyi, and Misha. Her signature Light Cone 'Until the Flowers Bloom Again' reruns on the Bygone Reminiscence banner for the same period.
events.gameplay: Standard Character Event Warp rerun: spend Star Rail Special Passes with the usual pity and 50/50 featured guarantee.
events.rewardsSummary: Warp banner (no event rewards); featured 5-star Evanescia + 4-star Qingque/Xueyi/Misha; 'Until the Flowers Bloom Again' Light Cone rerun on Bygone Reminiscence

events.title: Astral Slammers Squad!
events.summary: Permanent co-op bumper-fight event: team up and launch your Astral Imagea pets at baby seals for 500 Stellar Jade and more.
events.description: To celebrate the grand opening of Imagea Park, the IPC hosts the Astral Slammers challenge. Team up with a friend or via matchmaking and launch your Imageas at baby seals across co-op bumper-fight stages. The event is permanently available from 28 Sep 2026 with no end date, and features Easy and Hard Challenge stages (5 each). Trial Imageas can be used if you own none.
events.gameplay: Pick your Imageas (each player brings two; each Imagea has a unique ability), team up with one other Trailblazer, and defeat baby seals together across Easy and Hard Challenge stages.
requirements: Complete the 'Knowledge, Science, Passing By' Trailblaze Mission (part of Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise)
Trailblaze Level 21+ to unlock early via Finality's Vision

events.title: 4.6 Planar Fissure
events.summary: Double Planar Ornament drops from Simulated Universe and Divergent Universe Worlds a set number of times per day.
events.description: The recurring Planar Fissure bonus event returned on 12 Oct 2026 and runs through 25 Oct 2026. During the event, receive double rewards when obtaining Immersion Rewards or performing Ornament Extraction in the Simulated Universe (and Divergent Universe Worlds), for a limited number of double-reward claims that do not reset during the event.
events.gameplay: Clear Simulated/Divergent Universe Worlds; a limited pool of double-reward opportunities yields 2x Planar Ornaments (consume Immersifiers or Trailblaze Power as usual).

rewards.note: 2x Planar Ornament drops for a limited number of claims; no direct jade reward

events.rewardsSummary: Double Planar Ornament drops (no direct jade)

events.title: Interastral Peace Gala: One Take
events.summary: Star in Interastral Peace Entertainment's reality show by clearing combat scripts while satisfying the director's demands.
events.description: Interastral Peace Entertainment's blockbuster reality show has begun filming and the Trailblazer is cast as its next star. Each script has a director with special requests that raise your performance rating when fulfilled, and 'highlight moments' call in co-stars with unique support abilities. Earning a Perfect Curtain Call on every script awards the Silver Screen Legend medal for the Trailblazer's room.
events.gameplay: Assemble a team per script, complete the director's objectives during combat for a higher performance rating, and trigger co-star highlight moments to aim for Perfect Curtain Call clears.
requirements: None listed (preview; requirements to be confirmed at launch)

events.title: Overdrive: Whirlwind Grand Prix
events.summary: Astropolis racing-management event awarding up to 1,000 Stellar Jade and the free 4-star Light Cone 'Race to the Horizon'.
events.description: The brand-new racing grand prix in Astropolis emulates the Phantasmoon Games, with the winning team ascending as the God of Traffic (Laws). As team principal for Penacony's Speed Co, you assign drivers (including Jiaoqiu and Topaz), plan strategies, R&D car parts, and call the races across two competitions: the Astropolis Cup and the Cosmic Cup, each with 7 main races and R&D nodes.
events.gameplay: Manage the team between races (drivers, R&D parts, strategy) and then race to victory; winning 3 main races grants the free Light Cone and 14 race wins grant all its Superimposition materials.
requirements: Complete 'The Challenge Ends, and Now...' Trailblaze Continuance (How to Lose Your Way to the Top: The Zero-Dollar Strategy)
Trailblaze Level 21+ to unlock early via Finality's Vision
